WACH 501.title: Team Science in Women+ and Children's Health Research
WACH 501.description: Interdisciplinary approaches across the four health research pillars (biomedical, clinical, health services, population health); principles of team science; design of collaborative and equitable health research.

WACH 502.title: Seminars in Women+ and Children's Health
WACH 502.description: Biological and social determinants of health, health equity and inclusion.

WACH 503.title: Perinatal Epidemiology
WACH 503.description: Indicators of maternal/newborn well-being across population subgroups, changing trends in obstetrical intervention, perinatal morbidity, and the analysis of perinatal data.

WACH 504.title: Critical Appraisal of Research in Reproductive and Children's Health Sciences
WACH 504.description: Principles of critical thinking and appraisal of medical literature with respect to study design and causal inference.

WACH 505.title: Fundamentals of Magnetic Resonance Imaging
WACH 505.description: Physics behind MRI and basic principles. Image weighting/contrast, special encoding and image formation, pulse sequences, and hardware. Advanced techniques (functional, diffusion, quantitative, phase- based, spectroscopy) and their applications in women+ and children's health.

WACH 506.title: Knowledge Translation and Implementation Sciences
WACH 506.description: Strategies to promote uptake of innovations and evidence in healthcare from bench to bedside to populations.

WACH 511.title: Women+ Health Research
WACH 511.description: Sexual development, transgender medicine, reproduction and pregnancy, chronic and acute diseases, and social determinants of health.

WACH 512.title: Women's Mental Health Across Their Lifecycle
WACH 512.description: Multidisciplinary approach; interactions with reproductive health and concepts in women's mental health research.

WACH 514.title: Overview of Gynecologic Oncology
WACH 514.description: Molecular biology, epidemiology, prevention, and treatment of gynecologic cancers, including uterine cancer, vulvar/vaginal cancer, cervical cancer, ovarian cancer, and how to incorporate the patient experience into research.

WACH 521.title: Child Health Research
WACH 521.description: Biology of human development, child growth and puberty, adolescent health, childhood chronic and acute diseases, gender diversity in pediatrics, social environment and child health, and pediatric research in partnership with Indigenous communities.

WACH 522.title: Pediatric Nutrition
WACH 522.description: Dietary assessment and nutrient requirements in children and youth, assessment of growth and adiposity, application of nutritional biochemistry and animal models, energy balance, macronutrient and micronutrient metabolism and research, restricted diets in children, nutritional interventions in children.

WACH 531.title: Reproductive Endocrinology
WACH 531.description: Neuroendocrine regulation of reproduction, regulation of the ovarian and testicular function.

WACH 532.title: Physiology of the Mother, Fetus and Newborn
WACH 532.description: Functional development of the placenta and major organ systems in the fetal and newborn period in man and animals.

WACH 533.title: Fetal and Perinatal Metabolism
WACH 533.description: Nutrient metabolism and requirements during fetal and perinatal development and research methods used to assess requirements; developmental origins of health and disease; gestational obesity and diabetes; nutritional supplements during pregnancy.

WACH 540.title: Emerging Topics in Experimental Medicine
WACH 540.description: Restricted to students in Master of Science in Women+ and Children's Health Sciences or Doctor of Philosophy in Women+ and Children's Health Sciences.

WACH 548.title: Directed Studies in Women+ and Children's Health
WACH 548.description: Student-directed literature-based or experimental investigation of a topic.
